legacy.keyUnavailable: The keys saved by the old version could not be unlocked with Windows secure storage. The old version's files are unchanged, so the key import can be retried later.
legacy.secretUnreadable: A key saved by the old version cannot be decrypted and was skipped.
legacy.fileNewer: A file of the old version was created by a newer version of the app and was not transferred.
legacy.fileInvalid: A file of the old version is damaged and was not transferred.
legacy.fileUnreadable: A file of the old version could not be read and was not transferred.
